text: I Schedule: Time Note Application deadline Jun. 15, 2013 Send the scanned passport copy to service@cucas.cn Registration from Jul.14, 2013 to Jul.15 Lessons from Jul. 16, 2013 to Aug.3, 1.Jul. 16, 2012(Monday) the lessons start,Aug.3 (Friday) end. 2. 3 weeks with 80 class meeting hours. II Courses: Course Academic Hour Comprehensive Chinese 26 Spoken &Listening Chinese Chinese culture Note： 1.In order to accurately assess program level, new students have to participate the placement exam before the start. Students will be assigned to the appropriate class level based on the results of the exam. Beginners are assigned without a placement exam, and allowed to start Intermediate program after coming. 2.Students who have completed 80 class hours and passed all the course examinations will be granted a certificate of completion. III Tuition (RMB) Item Fees (Yuan) Application fee 400 RMB Fees for course books Based on a actual amount of course books Tuition fee 2500 RMB/person Accommodation fee 80 RMB/bed/day/person Deposit 1000 RMB Note： 1. We offer 2-bedroom apartment for accommodation with 4 students sharing. 2.Jul. 16 throughAug.5 (including), accommodation fee is 80 RMB/bed/day, the normal hotel accommodation fees (380 RMB/day/room; 760RMB/day/suit) will be charged beforeJul. 16 and afterAug.5. 3. A 1000 RMB deposit is required at check-in and will be refunded when check-out. 4. Any damage caused to the dormitory equipment by students will be fined. 5. Short-term students are not allowed to use kitchen which is only for long term students. An unauthorized use of kitchen or any damage caused to the kitchen equipment will be fined. IV Free items for short-term students: 1. Free transportion for the group of applicants (more than ten students, including ten) from Longjiaying railway station or Qinhuangdao port to the university. 2. One fieldtrip around Qinhuangdao city; 3. 400 RMB application fee exemption for students from a sister university or groups of more than 10 people . V Other: The following documents are required when registered: Original passport and visa and the copies. P.S. The duration of visa should not be shorter than one month (University will not accept any visa application for short-term students)
